rows.label: tlk70000008_05_msg0001
rows.name:
I said the squad had gone
downhill, but lately, everyone
is doing their duty properly.

rows.label: tlk70000008_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I guess with the state of the
world lately, even those layabouts
had to change their tune.

rows.label: tlk70000008_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Sure, we've had a few leave, but we've
also been getting some new blood. And
that's real good for the squad.

rows.label: tlk70000008_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Not because it means more decent
soldiers. It's good that more people
realize what they want to protect.

rows.label: tlk70000008_05_msg0005
rows.name:
It's too late to realize after losing
it. One fool like me is enough.
Gwahaha!
